silentZones.explanation: Idukki (pop 1,108,974) has a damage ratio of 50%, at or above the regional median. Its pre-event baseline was 9.7 local voices/day; allowing for the regional surge (x1.15) we expected 33.5 voices in 72 h and heard 10 (70% below expectation, residual 3.99). Rules fired: A (residual), B (drop), F (fusion with outage evidence). Independent evidence: night lights down 68%; 77% of cell sites reported down. Reported evacuation: 9% of population; after removing evacuees the district is still too quiet. Advisory flag: verify through another channel before acting.

Pathanamthitta (pop 1,197,412) has a damage ratio of 67%, at or above the regional median. Its pre-event baseline was 12.1 local voices/day; allowing for the regional surge (x1.15) we expected 41.9 voices in 72 h and heard 19 (55% below expectation, residual 3.46). Rules fired: A (residual), B (drop), F (fusion with outage evidence). Independent evidence: night lights down 79%; 77% of cell sites reported down. Reported evacuation: 26% of population; after removing evacuees the district is still too quiet. Advisory flag: verify through another channel before acting.
